question: What is 'Supply Chain' in business?

options.text: A chain of businesses that supply products to each other
Chain of command in a corporation
A network of all the entities involved in the production and distribution of a product
Total stock of a product in the market

solution:
The correct answer is __**A network of all the entities involved in the production and distribution of a product**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **supply chain** is a network of all the entities involved in the production and distribution of a product, including suppliers, manufacturers, and retailers.
 
• The supply chain encompasses all the steps required to get a product from raw materials to the final customer.
 
• Effective supply chain management is crucial for reducing costs and increasing efficiency in business operations.
 
• Key components of a supply chain include procurement, production, distribution, and logistics.
 
• Supply chains can be complex and global, involving multiple organizations and countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Supply chain management (SCM) involves the coordination and management of all activities involved in sourcing, procurement, conversion, and logistics management.
 
• SCM aims to enhance customer value and gain a competitive advantage in the market.
 
• Technological advancements such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, and the Internet of Things (IoT) are transforming supply chains by providing better visibility and control.
 
• Global supply chains have been significantly impacted by events such as the COVID-19 pandemic, highlighting the importance of resilience and adaptability.
